description: This file defines the Download model class for the Opencart e-commerce system, handling database interactions related to downloads such as retrieving download records, getting total downloads, and adding download reports.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: A model class for managing download records within the Opencart system, including methods to fetch individual downloads, list downloads with pagination, count total downloads, and log download reports.

methods.name: getDownload
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific download based on its ID, filtered by order statuses associated with the customer.

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Retrieves a list of download records with pagination, filtered by customer ID, store ID, and language preferences.

methods.name: getTotalDownloads
methods.description: Counts the total number of download records for the current customer within the specified order statuses.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Logs a report of a download event, recording IP address, country, and associated download ID.
